body:
1. In hooks/policy/constants.mjs, add 'manage_task' to ORCHESTRATION_TOOLS, and add 'find_by_name' to READ_ONLY_TOOLS and READ_TOOL_PATH_SCHEMAS.
2. In bin/hook-runner.sh line 192, add fallback read-only tool matchers for manage_task and find_by_name.
3. In bin/hook-runner.sh line 169, ensure missing Node runtime (exit 86) on 0-byte stdin in an ADLC repository fails closed.
4. In hooks/policy/paths.mjs line 116, fold case on platform === 'win32' as well as 'darwin', and normalize Windows drive letter paths in physicalResolve.
5. In lib/active-rails.mjs line 70, exclude Windows drive roots (curr === dirname(curr)) alongside '/'.
6. Rebuild hook bundle: npm run build:hooks.

Verification: npm test && node test/policy-guard.test.mjs
title: Add manage_task and find_by_name to policy guard taxonomy, fix Windows path folding, and fail closed on empty input
